caption: The drawing features two human figures, one on the left and one on the right, standing on either side of a large, decorative urn with the inscription “he died lamented.” The female figure on the left is dressed in a long pink and red gown with a veil and appears to be wiping her eye with one hand. The figure on the right, dressed in pale blue and white, has one arm raised and the other arm at her side. Both figures stand beneath two stylized, arching trees with green and yellow fronds. Above them and forming a canopy between the trees is a brown and curling vine, from which hang clusters of purple and brown grapes. The background is a beige or tan color. On either side of the central scene are floral arrangements with large, multi-petaled flowers in various shades of pink, white, yellow, and red, as well as green leaves and small buds. At the lower center, beneath the urn and figures, is a block of text in black ink or thread. Below the text, along the bottom edge, are two small houses with brown roofs and doorways on the left and right sides, separated by three narrow green trees. The composition is symmetrical and framed in a rectangular format, with intricate floral and botanical details surrounding the central figures and urn.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
